title: How to make your backyard a living history book.
subtitle: Incorporating design and documentation into the garden experience.
excerpt: A deep dive into making your yard's history and evolution part of the main attraction, turning simple gardening into immersive design narrative. We look at documentation methods that actually work in a backyard setting.
kicker: The newsletter for gardeners who’d rather learn from a mistake made 40 years ago than repeat it themselves.
callToAction: What is the most surprising change you’ve seen in your garden over the years? Share photos or stories with us!
